note_en: 不管…还是…，只要…就… stacks two patterns: 不管加班到很晚，还是懒得做饭，只要打开手机上的外卖软件，就能… "whether you've worked late or just can't be bothered to cook, all you have to do is open the delivery app and you can …" 不管 sets aside the circumstances ("no matter"), and 只要…就… gives the one condition that is enough. In English "as long as" or "all you need to do is" usually sounds more natural than a literal "only if."
